correctness.rationale: Each pair of distinct unit circles switches endpoint order only finitely often. On an active interval h is the average of two unit circular caps plus a constant. Strict Jensen convexity gives curvature >=1 with equality iff projected center heights match. A finite disk intersection only has open circular boundary arcs of curvature 1. Conversely equality makes each of finitely many arcs circular; by the established planar ball-body preservation theorem each arc's unit circle supports and contains the entire output, and finitely many such containing disks reconstruct the body. The two-disk lens has a stable mixed interval at height zero when both center separation components are nonzero; kappa0=(1-q²)^(-3/2)>1. Exact symbolic derivative checked for rational p=3/10,q=2/5. No sampling is used to prove a universal statement.
